treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Malta and the Government of the Kingdom of Bahrain for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2010)
eif_quote: that the Convention has entered into force on the 28 February 2012.
source_title: S.L. 123.132 Double Taxation Relief on Taxes on Income with the Kingdom of Bahrain Order (Schedule: 2010 Convention)

rates.quote: Dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State provided that such resident is the beneficial owner of the dividends.
Income from debt-claims arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Effective in both States for income derived from 1 Jan following EIF (Art. 26(2)) -> 2013-01-01. Art. 11 is titled 'Income from debt-claims' (interest equivalent). All three categories exclusive to the residence State. MLI: covered; Malta reserved Art. 8; PPT effective for WHT from 2023-01-01 (merged dataset).
